Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1001146": As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service.  (about: Ember team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000687": Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000682": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000279" [constraint]: The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000128": The reporting service is owned by team Dune.  (about: team Dune, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000362": feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: feature-flags, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1000856": As of 2025-12-05, the Ember team owns reporting, which team Dune owned until then.  (about: team Dune, Ember team, reporting)
- memory_id "1000852": As of 2025-12-05, the pager for reporting rings the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, reporting)
- memory_id "1000986": On 2026-02-16, team Dune noticed that the product catalog's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.  (about: team Dune, product catalog, the client rollout)
- memory_id "1000694": Team Dune noticed that the bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: team Dune, the bus, the traffic shift)
- memory_id "1000900": Team Dune observed that the bus' request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: team Dune, the bus, the client rollout)
- memory_id "1001157" [decision]: As of 2026-04-14, Farah holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, taking over from Tomasz; Tomasz held it as of 2026-03-11, and Farah held it as of 2026-01-16.  (about: Tomasz, Farah, team Dune)
- memory_id "1001026" [decision]: As of 2026-03-09, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team; the 2026-02-11 handover note that said team Dune was written against the wrong team, and Dune never owned it.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, team Dune, Ember team)
- memory_id "1001064": On 2026-03-11, the Cinder team observed that the billing API's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Cinder team, billing API, the runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1001151" [decision]: Tomasz was off the on-call rotation for team Dune until 2026-03-11, when he took the Dune pager; on 2026-04-14 he handed the pager to Farah.  (about: Tomasz, Farah, team Dune)
- memory_id "1001121": On 2026-04-08, the Atlas team saw that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout and flagged it as not their service.  (about: Atlas team, the client rollout, webhooks)
- memory_id "1000742": On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the image resizer's owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer, the marketing send)
- memory_id "1000771": On 2025-11-04, the Ember team saw that the billing service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it as not their service.  (about: Ember team, the marketing send, billing service)
- memory_id "1000955" [decision]: As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team does a no-deploy Friday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000838": On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team reported that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, billing API, the dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000889": On 2025-12-25, the Atlas team observed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change.  (about: Atlas team, reports pipeline, the retention change)
- memory_id "1000910": On 2025-12-31, the Atlas team saw that feature-flags' queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it as not their service.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, the marketing send)
- memory_id "1000281": Team Dune observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: team Dune, the cache change, notification service)
